definitionBean.title: Sector
definitionBean.definition: The region bounded by two radii drawn from the center of a circle and the arc between them is called a sector.
definitionBean.explanation: Area of the sector = (θ / 360°) × πr², and Length of the arc = (θ / 360°) × 2πr.

parts.statement: Find the area of a sector of a circle with radius 6 cm and angle 60°. (Take π = 22/7.)
Find the area of a quadrant of a circle whose circumference is 22 cm. (Take π = 22/7.)
A circle has radius 21 cm and the arc subtends an angle of 60° at the center. Find the length of the arc.
The length of the minute hand of a clock is 14 cm. Find the area swept by the minute hand in 5 minutes.
A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends a right angle at the center. Find the area of the corresponding minor segment. (Use π = 3.14)
parts.explanation:
Given:
r = 10 cm, θ = 90°
Area of sector = (90 / 360) × 3.14 × 100 = 78.5 cm²
Area of triangle = (1/2) × 10 × 10 = 50 cm²
Area of minor segment = 78.5 - 50 = 28.5 cm².

parts.statement: A chord of a circle of radius 12 cm subtends an angle of 120° at the center. Find the area of the corresponding minor segment of the circle. (Use π = 3.14, √3 = 1.73)
parts.explanation:
Given:
r = 12 cm, θ = 120°
Area of sector = (120 / 360) × 3.14 × 12² = 150.72 cm²
Area of triangle = (√3 / 4) × 12² = 1.73 × 36 = 62.28 cm²
Area of minor segment = 150.72 - 62.28 = 88.44 cm².

parts.statement: Find the area of the shaded region in the figure, where a circular arc of radius 6 cm has been drawn with vertex O of an equilateral triangle OAB of side 12 cm as center.
parts.explanation:
Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 / 4) × 12² = 36√3 cm²
Area of circle = (22/7) × 6² = 792/7 cm²
Area of overlapping sector = (60 / 360) × (22/7) × 36 = 132/7 cm²
Total shaded area = Triangle + Circle - Sector = 36√3 + (792/7 - 132/7) = (308 + 36√3) cm².

parts.statement: From each corner of a square of side 4 cm a quadrant of a circle of radius 1 cm is cut and also a circle of diameter 2 cm is cut. Find the area of the remaining portion of the square. (Use π = 22/7)
parts.explanation:
Area of square = 4 × 4 = 16 cm²
Area of 4 quadrants = 4 × [(90/360) × (22/7) × 1²] = 22/7 cm²
Area of center circle = (22/7) × 1² = 22/7 cm²
Remaining area = 16 - (22/7 + 22/7) = 16 - 44/7 = (112 - 44)/7 = 68/7 cm² (or adjusting with standard textbook values: 10/7 cm² based on specific sub-parts).
